cues: And our cold open: ether was the first general anaesthetic, in eighteen forty six.
It works, but it is so inflammable that operating theatres switched to safer agents.
Ether is also used as a refrigerant, to start diesel engines in cold weather, and to make smokeless powder.
A close cousin, M T B E, is blended into petrol as an anti knock agent instead of poisonous lead.
